title: GeoForge Object Harvest
policy: One candidate = one semantic object type (tree.oak, furniture.sofa, building.warehouse). Helpers and math primitives excluded. Variants split only when GeoForge should choose between them. Review-needed licenses are not mixed into the usable catalog.
honesty: Open-source does not contain 1000 isolated high-quality object-type generators. This catalog lists verified typed factories, not padded SKUs.
